scope: SF03 full-size 450x400x900 mm chair screening. Explicit user-selected historical functional loads; not a comparison of numerical results with the old 90x80x180 mm control. Not wood material certification or proof of real TabSlot retention.
coordinate_convention: Assembly frame in mm: X left/right, Y back (+Y), Z up; footprint centred at X=Y=0, feet at Z=0, seat top within Z=300..600, back load on rear-facing (+Y) surfaces above Z=600. Local part origins may differ; the existing assembly transforms map them to these frozen regions. Retain descriptive seat/back/leg or foot/frame components for semantic region lookup. Do not edit these analysis regions or rename components to evade loads.

material.name: isotropic_PLA_screening_proxy
material.evidence: Reuse experiments/standing_fea_30/configs/fea_chair_stool.json. Uniform isotropic experimental assumption; reddish-brown wood appearance does not establish physical wood properties.

fea.limit_basis: 25 MPa = historical proxy yield 50 MPa / design factor 2, matching the assembly demo stress limit. 5 mm is the declared functional-displacement screening limit reused from the assembly demo, not a material constant or a cited chair standard. Mesh convergence remains NOT_EVALUATED.
fea.unverified_policy: Missing regions, invalid mesh, unmatched tie or reaction/interface residual remain INDETERMINATE. Do not relax tolerances or use diagnostic stresses to drive geometry repair. Only valid evaluated stress/displacement violations are actionable.
